ja.reading: ぎゃくさんかくかんすうのどうかんすう

definition_ja: (arcsin x)′ = 1/√(1 − x²)、(arctan x)′ = 1/(1 + x²) などの公式。
definition_en: The formulas for the derivatives of the inverse trigonometric functions, such as (arcsin x)′ = 1/√(1 − x²) and (arctan x)′ = 1/(1 + x²).
spoken_en: the derivative of arctan x is one over one plus x squared

examples.en: The derivative of arctan x is one over one plus x squared.
examples.ja: arctan x の導関数は 1/(1 + x²)。

examples.en: Find the derivative of y = arcsin(2x).
examples.ja: y = arcsin(2x) の導関数を求めよ。

pitfalls: 日本の高校では逆三角関数を扱わない。arcsin x は inverse sine とも言い、sin⁻¹ x とも書く（1/sin x ではない）。

sources.title: College Board, AP Calculus AB and BC Course and Exam Description (Effective Fall 2020)
